title: A Systematic Evaluation of Preference Aggregation in Federated RLHF for Pluralistic Alignment of LLMs
reasoning: The paper develops an evaluation framework for 'pluralistic alignment' to align LLMs with diverse human values and social norms. Its benchmarking experiments specifically utilize the Pew Research Center’s Global Attitudes Surveys, which include 'religion' as a key demographic topic for evaluating group-specific preferences and fairness in model alignment.
